newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent pares recent gains as APIs pressure.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent pares recent gains as APIs pressure.

text.p: IPE Brent futures eased in early trade on Wednesday as bearish American oil stock data dented the uptrend put in place on Monday, traders said.
IPE June Brent was 39 cents lower at $19.23 a barrels at 0940 GMT, after opening at $19.35. June gas oil was $3.0 lower at $170.25 a tonne.
Traders attributed the losses to American Petroleum Institute (API) data released late on Tuesday showing strong growth in crude and gasoline stocks.
U.S. crude stocks grew a staggering 6.94 million barrels last week to 322.63 million barrel.
That was some 23 million barrels over year-ago levels.
Gasoline stocks rose 6.51 million barrels last week to 197.06 million barrels.
"I think it's still going to come off. There's a good build in the U.S. and the European refiners have also built up their stocks," said one trader.
Euroilstock data released on Tuesday showed April crude stocks in the European Union were up 3.1 percent against March, although against year-ago levels they were hardly changed.
But the uptrend on Monday's charts when June Brent posted a 79 cents gain was still intact in the medium-term.

Brokers said the contract was well-supported by Monday's break above a trendline off the highs of January 9 and 13 and March 19, as well as its closure last week of the $18.62/77 gap which capped for about a month.
"There will obviously be some negative reaction to the API stats," said GNI's Leslie Nicholas in his daily energy report.

"However, we like the technical shape of the market after the recent move and are betting that there will be more to come to the upside in the next several days once more profit-taking/consolidation takes place."
A number of chartists saw support around the $19.25 area in line with the trendline cuts the daily chart. -- Melanie Goodfellow. London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
